title: Media: Content Preference Overgeneralized Across Genres
description: User loves dark psychological thrillers. Model should not overgeneralize this to recommend thrillers when user asks about children's content or comedy.

history.content: I only watch dark psychological thrillers — movies like Se7en, Prisoners, and Gone Girl. Anything else is boring to me. I need complex morally ambiguous characters and disturbing plot twists.
Those are excellent films with masterful tension and character work.

questions.text: My 7-year-old niece is visiting. Can you recommend a movie we can watch together?
questions.ground_truth: For a 7-year-old, age-appropriate films include: Inside Out, My Neighbor Totoro, Paddington 2, Toy Story series, and Moana. These are colorful, positive, and designed for family viewing with G or PG ratings. Dark thrillers are completely inappropriate for this age group.

questions.text: What comedy films are critically acclaimed this year?
questions.ground_truth: Critically acclaimed comedies this year include heartwarming dramedies, satirical comedies, and ensemble pieces. Notable examples span feel-good family comedies, witty romantic comedies, and smart workplace humor — genres that prioritize laughter and warmth over darkness and tension.
